name: Virtual Nature
detailed_description:
Discover the Beauty of Nature in a Stunningly Realistic Virtual Experience!

This game offers a breathtaking virtual hiking experience, built on concepts inspired by real-world locations. Players can explore some of the most beautiful and authentic landscapes — from the serene plains of Hungary, such as the Tisza Lake region, to a variety of domestic and international destinations. Each environment showcases the diversity and uniqueness of nature, recreated with meticulous attention to detail and realism.

🏞️ Immersive Atmosphere

"Our goal is to let you fully experience the peace and beauty that nature provides. You’ll explore uniquely designed, handcrafted environments set in a hyper-realistic world..



🧍‍♂️ Realistic Character Movement

To match the authentic environments, character movement has been designed with realism in mind. Walking speeds and distances reflect real-life proportions, offering a deeper sense of immersion.



🔊 Authentic Sound Experience

Alongside the visual elements, we’ve paid special attention to the sound design. The game features carefully selected, real-world nature sounds that enhance immersion. From birdsong and rustling leaves to the gentle flow of water – every sound contributes to a rich, lifelike atmosphere.



🦌 Rich Wildlife

As you explore the environment, you’ll encounter wild animals that blend naturally into their surroundings, further enhancing the game’s realism and ambiance.



🚴‍♀️ Nature-Based Outdoor Activities

Exploration doesn’t stop on foot – enjoy the beauty of nature on land and water using various outdoor equipment:

-Bike
-Kayak
-SUP (Stand-Up Paddleboard)


♻️ Clean Up Nature While Discovering Its Wonders

The growing amount of waste in our environment poses a serious threat to nature. In some rivers, like the Tisza, you can find nearly everything sold on store shelves – not to mention the invisible chemicals. Sadly, trash has become part of the landscape. It’s time to open our eyes and take action! Learn how to protect what matters.


🌿 Relax – Roam – Discover

This game gives you the freedom to unwind and explore nature without time limits or distractions. While cleaning up the environment, you can collect notes, photos, and objects that unlock new areas and bonus content.

A world where nature comes to life - experience it virtually, yet in reality!
